messages:
maria_dev: Starting phased rollout for inference-runtime v2.3.0. Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Plan: 0 → 1% → 5% → 20% → 50%, ~60m between steps. Target regions: global; ap-south and eu-west as early samples. @deploy-bot kick off ap-south sample bake. Release notes: perf tweaks to kv-cache + attention kernel.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Initiating sample bake: ap-south-1. Job: bake-1769994321. Link: https://deploys.internal/jobs/bake-1769994321. ETA ~12m.

ajay: FYI saw a small regression in staging yesterday — 502 spike when kvcache hits eviction path. I pushed micro-fix kvcache-fix-1. Recommend holding eu-west at 5% and pin to v2.2.9 if errors > 1%.

linda_oncall: Observability check: 95p latency eu-west baseline 120ms -> 260ms at 01:10 UTC under ~3% traffic. Error rate (502) 0.9% and trending up. Recommend HOLD at 5% and rollback if 502 > 1% sustained for 15m. :warning:

jordan: quick logs paste:
```
[01:09:34] inference service: request -> 502 upstream: kvcache eviction OOM
[01:10:02] p50 140ms p95 260ms
```
Also small increase in upstream retries.

product_ops: do we need to update customer-facing release notes? This is a perf/infra change — recommend internal ops note unless SLA impact shows.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 1% (ap-south) complete. bake-1769994321: ✅. eu-west ramp is queued but paused pending manual confirmation.

maria_dev: OK start ap-south at 5% if bake stays green. For eu-west: hold at 5% and prepare pin to v2.2.9 if errors cross threshold. @deploy-bot prepare rollback plan and standby for manual execute.

deploy-bot: Rollback plan prepared: rr-1769994321. Ready to execute rollback/pin on eu-west on command.

linda_oncall: 10m check: eu-west 502 now 1.3% averaged over last 5m. Escalating to rollback recommendation.

maria_dev: Decision: HOLD eu-west. Execute rollback -> v2.2.9 and pin traffic. Keep ap-south at 5% and monitor for 30m. Notifying support. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for eu-west -> v2.2.9 (rr-1769994321). Rollback completed at 1769994440. eu-west traffic pinned to v2.2.9.

ajay: running quick sanity now — ap-south p95 stable ~130ms. I'll open PR for the kvcache eviction fix (longer-term).

product_ops: Notifying subscription 'inference-notices' about partial rollback in EU; note says no expected SLA impact.

maria_dev: Thanks all. Holding the phased rollout until kvcache fix merges and we verify in staging. Will reopen thread when ready to retry. Closing for now.
